plugin.description: Connect StreamController keys to any WebSocket server using the SC/WS v1 protocol.
plugin.requirements: A WebSocket server that speaks SC/WS v1, reachable from this computer.

WebSocketKey.description: Shows text, images and colors pushed by a WebSocket server and publishes this key's presses to it.

channel.description: Stable name for this key. Leave empty to use the generated deck/position name.

default_text.description: Text shown before the server sends anything.

default_icon.description: Absolute path to the default icon image.

extra.description: Extra JSON merged into every event from this key.

show_offline_dot.description: Draw a small red dot while the WebSocket is disconnected.
